title: Help Desk
description: Provide technical support to employees by troubleshooting hardware, software, and network issues. Assist users with system access, installations, and day-to-day IT needs.
responsibilities: Respond to IT help requests via phone, email, or ticketing system.
Diagnose and resolve technical issues in a timely manner.
Install and configure software, hardware, and peripherals.
Escalate unresolved issues to higher-level IT staff.
Maintain documentation of support requests and solutions.

title: Senior Planning Engineer
description: Responsible for preparing, monitoring, and updating project schedules to ensure timely execution of construction projects. Coordinate with project managers and site teams to align progress with baseline schedules.
responsibilities: Develop detailed project schedules using appropriate planning tools.
Monitor actual progress and compare it against planned timelines.
Identify potential delays and propose corrective actions.
Prepare progress reports for management and stakeholders.
Ensure compliance with contractual project milestones.

title: Tendering Engineer
description: Handle the preparation and submission of technical and financial proposals for new projects. Review tender documents and ensure all requirements are met to maximize the chance of winning bids.
responsibilities: Study tender documents and identify project requirements.
Prepare cost estimates, BOQs, and technical proposals.
Coordinate with different departments to gather necessary data.
Ensure tenders are submitted within deadlines and meet client specifications.
Participate in negotiations and clarification meetings with clients.
